title: Econazole Topical
overview: Econazole is used to treat skin infections such as athlete's foot, jock itch, and ringworm.

sections.Before using econazole,: tell your doctor and pharmacist if you are allergic to econazole or any other drugs.tell your doctor and pharmacist what prescription and nonprescription medications, vitamins, nutritional supplements, and herbal products you are taking or plan to take while using econazole. Your doctor may need to change the doses of your medications or monitor you carefully for side effects.tell your doctor if you are pregnant, plan to become pregnant, or are breast-feeding. If you become pregnant while using econazole, call your doctor.
sections.Econazole may cause side effects. If you: itchingburningirritationstingingrednessrashIf you experience a serious side effect, you or your doctor may send a report to the Food and Drug Administration's (FDA) MedWatch Adverse Event Reporting program online (https://www.fda.gov/Safety/MedWatch) or by phone (1-800-332-1088).
